nodes.summary: Sample CSV template defining the column layout for the Trendzo template leaderboard pulled into Google Sheets.

nodes.name: Trendzo.gs
nodes.summary: Google Apps Script add-on that bootstraps a Trendzo menu in Google Sheets to pull the leaderboard and push test conversion events to the Trendzo API.
nodes.languageNotes: Apps Script (.gs) module using SpreadsheetApp.onOpen menu pattern plus UrlFetchApp and PropertiesService to call Trendzo HTTP endpoints with an X-API-Key header.

nodes.name: onOpen
nodes.summary: Apps Script trigger that adds a Trendzo menu to the Google Sheets UI on spreadsheet open with Setup, Pull Leaderboard, and Push Conversions actions.

nodes.name: TZ_PullLeaderboard
nodes.summary: Fetches the Trendzo leaderboard for a given window from /api/templates/leaderboard and rewrites the Leaderboard sheet with template_id, title, metric_value, and rank columns.

nodes.name: TZ_PushConversionsTest
nodes.summary: Posts a sample purchase event to /api/pixel/collect using the stored API key to verify the Sheets-to-Trendzo conversion pipeline.

nodes.name: README.md
nodes.summary: Brief setup guide for the Trendzo Google Sheets pack covering CSV templates and Apps Script installation.
